title: CRWDWalla-Heurigen Wine Tavern Spring Evening Austrian Dialect Cheerful Chatter Wine Glasses Kahlenberg_Vienna by SiliconeSound
author: SiliconeSound
sourceDescription: Recorded on an unusually warm evening on the 1st of May (a public holiday in Austria) at a Heuriger wine tavern on the Kahlenberg near Vienna. The sun was low, the sky blue, and crowds were out celebrating the holiday. Captured with a pair of Clippy EM272 mics in stereo, positioned right in the middle of the crowd, into a Zoom F3. Raw, unedited recording featuring lively Austrian-dialect conversation (walla), clinking wine glasses, laughter, and the surrounding garden ambience.
modifications: cut 227.84-242.84s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain +0.00 dB (peak -7.50 dBFS); 30 ms fades
